candidates.description: Patch Next/Nest production framework lines while keeping committed Prisma 6.19.3; use targeted transitive overrides only in the isolated proposal.
Exploratory audit-only candidate: same patched framework set plus the npm-audit suggested Prisma 6.12.0 pair. Never auto-adopt; must pass full schema/build/regression before any commit.

notes: Proposal generation is isolated from the checked-out source tree.
The committed npm audit gate remains authoritative and is never bypassed.

Candidates are diagnostics only. A PASS candidate must still be manually adopted into source and pass deterministic npm ci, Prisma validation/generation, all regression, six-app build, PostgreSQL integration and browser UAT.

Prisma 6.12.0 appears only in the second exploratory candidate because npm audit currently recommends that downgrade for the @prisma/config/deepmerge-ts advisory; it must not be committed without compatibility proof.
